subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The scientific study of the structure and form of animals and plants
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Morphology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Morphology"** refers to the scientific study of the structure, form, and organization of animals and plants. (संरचना विज्ञान)

 
 
• **Example:** The morphology of flowers often helps botanists classify different plant species.
 
 
 
• **"Structure and form of animals and plants"** is the definition of Morphology, making it the most appropriate one-word substitute. (संरचना और रूप विज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example:** Researchers used morphology to analyze the skeletal differences between the two species.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Morphology)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Zoology** (प्राणी विज्ञान): The scientific study of animals, their biology, behavior, and classification.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to major in zoology to study the behavior of wild animals.
 
 
 
• **Biology** (जीव विज्ञान): The scientific study of life and living organisms.
 
 
• **Example:** Biology covers a wide range of topics, including genetics, ecology, and anatomy.
 
 
 
• **Botany** (वनस्पति विज्ञान): The scientific study of plants, including their physiology, structure, and classification.
 
 
• **Example:** Botany helps us understand the importance of plants in maintaining the ecosystem.
